answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 99 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in raven, queued in willow, and garden publishes the wait time. A farm of 380 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1774 identities would post 1291 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
